title: Owner request 2026-10-17: whole dialogue text, a large centred satchel and learned-knowledge book with few clear tabs, and a character-art readability pass
source: owner message of 2026-10-17 (Vietnamese): characters' dialogue must be shown whole, never cut; the satchel and the things learned must be large in the middle of the screen; fewer tabs, no hard-to-use filter tabs; improve character graphics; keep improving the game

items.title: Dialogue: every line, speaker name and answer shown whole (vi + en)
items.objective: No dialogue content is ever truncated: the speaker's name, every line and every answer choice are shown whole in Vietnamese and English at 1280x720 and 1280x800. Today `src/presentation/dialogue/dialogue_panel.gd` clips the speaker title and each answer row with an ellipsis (`clip_text` + `OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS`, answers in a 250 px column). A long answer wraps or the column/box grows within the dialogue band; a line too long for the box pages with a visible continue cue instead of being cut.
in_scope: src/presentation/dialogue/** and the dialogue sizes in src/presentation/ui/ui_palette.gd
a layout test that measures every authored dialogue line, speaker name and answer (data/dialogue/**, both languages) with the real font and asserts it fits or pages, never clips
tools/capture_ui.gd: capture an open dialogue with its longest answer set (vi 1280x720, en 1280x800)
out_of_scope: rewriting any dialogue text or canon

add the measuring layout test that is RED on the current build and GREEN after the change

constraints: the dialogue band must stay out of the playfield clear zone defined in docs/UI_UX_BIBLE.md; if it cannot, report the conflict instead of breaking the budget
keyboard selection and Esc behaviour unchanged (dialogue E2E stays green)

items.title: Satchel opens as a large centred book panel (reusable seam)
items.objective: The satchel (inventory + equipment sheet, today a narrow left side panel in src/presentation/hud/gameplay_hud.gd sized by UIPalette.SHEET_PANEL_WIDTH) opens as a LARGE CENTRED book panel that is easy to read: larger item rows and text, the paper-doll and stats beside the list, one obvious close key. Build it as a reusable centred-book seam (a presentation component with tab support) that ui-03 will reuse for the learned-knowledge book — foundation first, content second.
